sentences.zh: 但这不足以动摇琼斯。

sentences.en: Christine then argued for the lives of Jonestown's babies.
sentences.zh: 克里斯汀随后为琼斯镇的孩子们的生命进行了辩护。

sentences.en: The crowd heckled her.
sentences.zh: 人群起哄嘲笑她。

sentences.en: One woman mocked her for being afraid to die.
sentences.zh: 一名女子嘲笑她不敢死。

sentences.en: Jones told Christine that she'd regret it if she didn't die that day.
sentences.zh: 琼斯告诉克里斯汀，如果她那天不死，她会后悔的。

sentences.en: Desperate to have Jones see reason for them all to live, Christine asked him if he wanted to see
sentences.zh: 克里斯汀急于让琼斯为他们所有人活下去找到理由，她问他是否想看到

sentences.en: John die.
sentences.zh: 约翰死去。

sentences.en: She was referring to John Stullen, the little boy Jones claimed to be the biological father of.
sentences.zh: 她指的是约翰·斯图伦，琼斯声称自己是其生父的那个小男孩。

sentences.en: The boy Jones kidnapped and rushed to Guyana before his ex-temple mother could reclaim custody.
sentences.zh: 那个被琼斯绑架并匆忙带到圭亚那，以防其前圣殿母亲夺回监护权的男孩。

sentences.en: Jones replied, do you actually think I would put John's life above others?
sentences.zh: 琼斯回答说：你真的认为我会把约翰的生命置于他人之上吗？

sentences.en: He's not different to me than any of these children here.
sentences.zh: 对我来说，他和这里的任何孩子都没有区别。

sentences.en: For months I've tried to keep this thing from happening, but I know it's the will of sovereign being that this happened to us.
sentences.zh: 几个月来我一直试图阻止这件事发生，但我知道这是主宰者的旨意，让我们遭遇这一切。

sentences.en: That we lay down our lives in protest against what's being done.
sentences.zh: 我们要以牺牲生命来抗议正在发生的事情。

sentences.en: That we lay down our lives to protest in what's being done.
sentences.zh: 我们要以牺牲生命来抗议正在发生的事情。

sentences.en: The criminality of people, the cruelty of people, who walked out of here today?
sentences.zh: 那些今天离开这里的人的犯罪行为，人们的残忍？

sentences.en: Did you know those who walked out?
sentences.zh: 你知道那些离开的人吗？

sentences.en: Mostly white people.
sentences.zh: 大多是白人。

sentences.en: mostly white people walked
sentences.zh: 大多是白人离开了。

sentences.en: I'm so grateful for the ones that didn't those who knew who they are
sentences.zh: 我很感激那些没有离开的人，那些知道自己是谁的人。

sentences.en: there's no point there's no point to this we are born before our time
sentences.zh: 没有意义，这没有意义，我们生不逢时。

sentences.en: they won't accept us and I don't think we should sit here and take any more time for our children to be endangered because if they come after our children
sentences.zh: 他们不会接受我们，我不认为我们应该坐在这里，让我们的孩子再面临危险，因为如果他们来找我们的孩子，

sentences.en: and we give them our children then our children will suffer forever
sentences.zh: 而我们把孩子交给了他们，那么我们的孩子将永远受苦。

sentences.en: Christine Miller's opposing voice of reason became lost amongst the rambling audience.
sentences.zh: 克里斯汀·米勒反对的声音在喋喋不休的听众中消失了。

sentences.en: Suddenly, the flatbed truck that took Congressman Ryan and his delegation to Port Kytumas sped down the road, followed by the red tractor and trailer carrying the six gunmen.
sentences.zh: 突然，载着瑞安议员及其代表团前往凯图马港的平板卡车在路上疾驰而过，后面跟着载着六名枪手的红色拖拉机和拖车。

sentences.en: One of the guards rushed towards Jones, leapt on stage and whispered in his ear.
sentences.zh: 一名警卫冲向琼斯，跳上舞台，在他耳边低语。

sentences.en: Jones turned to the crowd and announced flatly.
sentences.zh: 琼斯转向人群，冷冷地宣布。

sentences.en: The congressman has been murdered.
sentences.zh: 议员被谋杀了。

sentences.en: moving.
sentences.zh: 行动起来。

sentences.en: Don't be afraid to die.
sentences.zh: 不要害怕死亡。

sentences.en: If these people land out here, they'll torture some of our children here.
sentences.zh: 如果这些人降落在这里，他们会折磨我们这里的一些孩子。

sentences.en: They'll torture our people.
sentences.zh: 他们会折磨我们的人民。

sentences.en: They'll torture our seniors.
sentences.zh: 他们会折磨我们的老人。

sentences.en: We cannot have this.
sentences.zh: 我们不能让这种情况发生。

sentences.en: Are you going to separate yourself from whoever shot the Congress?
sentences.zh: 你要和射杀议员的人划清界限吗？

sentences.en: I don't know who shot him.
sentences.zh: 我不知道是谁射杀了他。

sentences.en: A large steel drum was carried into the pavilion and placed on a table at the front.
sentences.zh: 一个巨大的钢桶被抬进凉亭，放在前面的桌子上。

sentences.en: Hundreds of paper cups and syringes were piled next to the drum.
sentences.zh: 数百个纸杯和注射器堆在桶旁边。

sentences.en: As Jones stuttered and slurred his way through his speech, the drum was filled with grape flavoured, non-carbonated soft drink.
sentences.zh: 当琼斯结结巴巴、含糊不清地演讲时，桶里装满了葡萄味的无气软饮料。

sentences.en: Jonestown residents had drunk the liquid many times before under the order of Jones, but in those past instances, the liquid was harmless.
sentences.zh: 琼斯镇的居民在琼斯的命令下喝过很多次这种液体，但在过去，这种液体是无害的。

sentences.en: Jonestown's medical staff, fronted by Dr. Larry Schacht, began to measure out various liquid poisons and medications, pouring large amounts into the vat of grape juice.
sentences.zh: 以拉里·沙赫特医生为首的琼斯镇医疗人员开始测量各种液体毒药和药物，倒入装满葡萄汁的大桶中。

sentences.en: Potassium cyanide, valium, chloral hydrate and potassium chloride were stirred in, turning the liquid brown.
sentences.zh: 氰化钾、安定、水合氯醛和氯化钾被搅拌进去，使液体变成了褐色。

sentences.en: Even as it was mixed before their eyes, Jonestown's residents couldn't believe that the vat contained poison.
sentences.zh: 即使在他们眼前混合，琼斯镇的居民也不敢相信桶里装的是毒药。

sentences.en: They convinced themselves that this was just another test to prove their loyalty to Jones.
sentences.zh: 他们说服自己，这只是又一次考验，以证明他们对琼斯的忠诚。

sentences.en: They weren't really about to die.
sentences.zh: 他们并不是真的要死。

sentences.en: Nurses began tearing open syringe packets and dipping them into the vat, drawing up the brown poison into their narrow tubes.
sentences.zh: 护士们开始撕开注射器包装，将其浸入桶中，将褐色的毒药吸入细管中。

sentences.en: One of Jim Jones' mistresses, Maria Katsuris, helped prepare the poisoned drink.
sentences.zh: 吉姆·琼斯的情妇之一，玛丽亚·卡苏里斯，帮忙准备了毒饮。

sentences.en: She climbed on stage and whispered in Jones' ear.
sentences.zh: 她爬上舞台，在琼斯耳边低语。

sentences.en: Jones was overheard asking her if there was any way to make the drink taste less bitter.
sentences.zh: 有人听到琼斯问她有没有办法让饮料的味道不那么苦。

sentences.en: Katsuris responded no.
sentences.zh: 卡苏里斯回答没有。

sentences.en: Jones then asked her if it was quick.
sentences.zh: 琼斯随后问她这是否很快。

sentences.en: Katsuris said yes.
sentences.zh: 卡苏里斯说是的。

sentences.en: It was supposed to be quick.
sentences.zh: 这应该是很快的。

sentences.en: Katsuris then turned to the crowd and ordered everyone to form orderly lines behind the table.
sentences.zh: 卡苏里斯随后转向人群，命令所有人排成整齐的队伍，站在桌子后面。

sentences.en: Babies and children would be first, then the adults.
sentences.zh: 婴儿和儿童排在最前面，然后是成年人。

sentences.en: Katsuri's instructed parents to keep children calm and told older children to reassure their younger siblings.
sentences.zh: 卡苏里斯指示家长们让孩子保持冷静，并告诉大一点的孩子安抚年幼的弟弟妹妹。

sentences.en: The first person to stand and approach the vat was a woman in her late 20s.
sentences.zh: 第一个站起来走向大桶的人是一位二十多岁的女性。

sentences.en: Calmly and deliberately, she walked up to the drum of poison with her one-year-old baby in her arMs.
sentences.zh: 她冷静而从容地抱着一岁的婴儿，走向装有毒药的桶。

sentences.en: Taking a needleless syringe, she filled the tube with poison and squirted the liquid into her baby's mouth.
sentences.zh: 她拿起一支无针注射器，吸满毒药，然后将液体喷进婴儿的嘴里。

sentences.en: She then consumed some for herself.
sentences.zh: 随后，她自己也喝了一些。

sentences.en: The mother walked out of the pavilion to the grassy field next door and sat down.
sentences.zh: 这位母亲走出凉亭，来到隔壁的草地上坐下。

sentences.en: Holding her baby close, she rocked him gently as he began to scream.
sentences.zh: 她紧紧抱着婴儿，在孩子开始尖叫时轻轻摇晃着他。

sentences.en: Hesitant mothers remained seated, holding their babies tight.
sentences.zh: 犹豫不决的母亲们仍坐在原处，紧紧抱着自己的孩子。

sentences.en: Initially polite, nurses gently convinced mothers to hand over their babies.
sentences.zh: 起初，护士们态度温和，劝说母亲们交出孩子。

sentences.en: When that didn't work, they called over the armed guards who pried babies from their frantic mother's arms and took them to the vat.
sentences.zh: 当劝说无效时，她们叫来了武装警卫，警卫强行从惊恐的母亲怀中夺走婴儿，并将他们带到大桶前。

sentences.en: When the babies were poisoned, they screamed and cried in agonising pain.
sentences.zh: 当婴儿被喂下毒药时，他们因剧痛而尖叫哭泣。

sentences.en: Katsuri's reassured worried parents by lying to them.
sentences.zh: 卡苏里斯通过撒谎来安抚焦虑的家长们。

sentences.en: The crying wasn't from pain, she stated, but due to the bitterness of the drink.
sentences.zh: 她声称，哭声并非因为疼痛，而是因为饮料太苦。

sentences.en: More mothers carried their babies to the vat, allowing poison to be shot down their throats.
sentences.zh: 更多的母亲抱着孩子走向大桶，任由毒药被灌进他们的喉咙。

sentences.en: Once all the babies were done, the children were next.
sentences.zh: 所有婴儿处理完后，接下来是孩子们。

sentences.en: Older children were aware of the horror around them.
sentences.zh: 大一点的孩子们意识到了周围发生的恐怖景象。

sentences.en: They saw babies writhing in pain in their mother's arms, their little bodies convulsing unnaturally and their eyes rolling back before they flopped completely still.
sentences.zh: 他们看到婴儿在母亲怀里痛苦地扭动，小小的身体不自然地抽搐，双眼翻白，随后彻底瘫软不动。

sentences.en: Shortly afterwards, their mothers would convulse, lose grip of their child and fall backwards dead.
sentences.zh: 不久之后，他们的母亲也会抽搐，松开怀里的孩子，向后倒地身亡。

sentences.en: Residents made reassuring speeches.
sentences.zh: 居民们发表了安抚人心的演讲。

sentences.en: All the while, the sound of children dying in pain drowned on in the background of their optimistic words.
sentences.zh: 与此同时，孩子们痛苦死去的尖叫声，始终掩盖在他们乐观的言辞背景中。

sentences.en: As one crying child was pushed forward and forced to drink, Jones called out, don't be afraid to die.
sentences.zh: 当一个哭泣的孩子被推上前被迫喝下毒药时，琼斯大喊道：“不要害怕死亡。”

sentences.en: Jones then pleaded with the crowd to get on with it, before saying, this is a revolutionary suicide.
sentences.zh: 琼斯随后恳求人群快点行动，并说道：“这是一场革命性的自杀。”

sentences.en: This is not a self-destructive suicide, so they'll pay for this.
sentences.zh: “这不是自我毁灭式的自杀，所以他们会为此付出代价。”

sentences.en: They brought this upon us and they'll pay for that.
sentences.zh: “是他们把这一切强加给我们，他们会为此付出代价。”

sentences.en: I leave that destiny to them.
sentences.zh: “我把那种命运留给他们。”

sentences.en: If everybody will relax, the best thing you can do is to relax and you'll have no probleMs. You'll have no problems with this thing if you just relax.
sentences.zh: “如果每个人都能放松，你能做的最好的事就是放松，这样你就不会有任何问题。只要你放松，这件事就不会给你带来任何问题。”

sentences.en: People's Temple member Tim Carter, quote, As I walked up to the back of the pavilion, I saw a woman named Rosie on the ground, crying, holding her dead baby.
sentences.zh: 人民圣殿教成员蒂姆·卡特回忆道：“当我走到凉亭后面时，我看到一个叫罗西的女人躺在地上，抱着她死去的婴儿哭泣。”

sentences.en: There were maybe eight or nine other people who were dying or in the process of dying.
sentences.zh: 当时还有八九个人正在死去，或者正处于死亡的过程中。

sentences.en: Inside, I just wanted things to stop.
sentences.zh: 在里面，我只想让这一切停止。

sentences.en: Please, let me catch my breath.
sentences.zh: 求求你，让我喘口气。

sentences.en: Let me figure out what's happening here.
sentences.zh: 让我弄清楚这里到底发生了什么。

sentences.en: I looked to my right.
sentences.zh: 我看向右边。

sentences.en: Then I saw my wife with our son in her arms and poison being injected into his mouth.
sentences.zh: 然后我看到我的妻子抱着我们的儿子，毒药正被注射进他的嘴里。

sentences.en: my son was dead and he was frothing at the mouth you know cyanide makes people froth at the mouth
sentences.zh: 我儿子死了，他口吐白沫，你知道氰化物会让人口吐白沫。

sentences.en: my wife died in my arms and my dead baby son was in her arms and i heard her and said i love you
sentences.zh: 我妻子死在我怀里，我死去的儿子就在她怀里，我听到她说我爱你。

sentences.en: i love you because that's all i could say she died in my arms residents were in shock everything felt too unreal to be true as the bodies of poisoned friends and family were
sentences.zh: 我爱你，因为我只能说出这句话，她死在我怀里，居民们陷入了震惊，一切都感觉太不真实了，就像被毒死的朋友和家人的尸体被

sentences.en: dragged out of the pavilion, those who remained struggled to rationalise the horror.
sentences.zh: 拖出凉亭，剩下的人努力想要理清这恐怖的一切。

sentences.en: When a poisoned 15-year-old boy who was directed out of the pavilion ran back in, collapsed against a pole,
sentences.zh: 当一个被喂了毒药的15岁男孩被指引走出凉亭后又跑回来，瘫倒在柱子旁，

sentences.en: wheezed, and began convulsing, the remaining residents were left with no doubt that this wasn't a hoax.
sentences.zh: 喘着粗气开始抽搐时，剩下的居民毫无疑问地意识到，这不是一场骗局。

sentences.en: It was very real, and people were dying.
sentences.zh: 这是非常真实的，人们正在死去。

sentences.en: Jones barked orders to get the dying boy out of the pavilion.
sentences.zh: 琼斯大声下令，要把那个垂死的男孩拖出凉亭。

sentences.en: Two men picked him up, and as they carried him to the field, his body went limp.
sentences.zh: 两名男子抬起他，当他们把他抬到草地上时，他的身体瘫软了。

sentences.en: A 12-year-old girl kept spitting out the poison when it was forced into her mouth.
sentences.zh: 一个12岁的女孩在毒药被强行灌入嘴里时，一直试图吐出来。

sentences.en: Agitated nurses grabbed her hair and pulled it backwards roughly, forcing her head back.
sentences.zh: 焦躁的护士抓住她的头发，粗暴地向后拉扯，强迫她仰起头。

sentences.en: They poured the poison down her throat and covered her mouth and nose, forcing her to swallow.
sentences.zh: 她们把毒药灌进她的喉咙，捂住她的口鼻，强迫她吞咽。

sentences.en: When people started saying their goodbyes, Jones blasted the crowd again and told them to hurry up.
sentences.zh: 当人们开始告别时，琼斯再次对人群咆哮，催促他们快点。

sentences.en: Armed guards aimed their weapons at those who were slow-moving.
sentences.zh: 武装警卫将武器对准了那些动作缓慢的人。

sentences.en: of those who secretly wanted to escape it seemed impossible now nurses approached people who were
sentences.zh: 对于那些暗中想要逃跑的人来说，现在似乎已经不可能了，护士们走向那些

sentences.zh: 明显处于休克状态的人，并给他们注射了装满毒药的针筒，警卫按住拒绝排队的人，护士强行给他们注射。

sentences.en: christine miller the woman who stood up against jones at the beginning of the meeting had to be forcibly injected stanley clayton quote i ain't never used the term suicide
sentences.zh: 克里斯汀·米勒，那个在会议开始时站出来反对琼斯的女人，不得不被强行注射。斯坦利·克莱顿说：“我从没用过‘自杀’这个词。”

sentences.en: and I ain't ever going to use the word suicide.

sentences.zh: 她只是处于恍惚状态。

sentences.zh: “我的母亲、祖母、姐姐、哥哥，他们都走了，”她说。

sentences.zh: 然后她走向毒药，走向那个死亡之桶，她没有丝毫犹豫。

sentences.zh: 人们痛苦死去的尖叫声：“有尊严地献出你的生命，不要带着泪水和痛苦躺下。”

sentences.zh: 就像马克斯说的，这只是跨入另一个位面。

sentences.zh: 停止歇斯底里。

sentences.zh: 蒂姆·卡特说：

sentences.zh: “他们被他妈的屠杀了。”

sentences.en: It has become part of me.
sentences.zh: 它已经成为我的一部分。

sentences.en: People ask if you knew then what you know now about
sentences.zh: 人们问，如果你当时就知道你现在所知道的关于

sentences.en: Jones's early life, about the decline of his personality, about the depravity and madness later.
sentences.zh: 琼斯早年的生活，关于他个性的衰落，关于后来他的堕落和疯狂。

sentences.en: Would you have gone to Jonestown?
sentences.zh: 你还会去琼斯镇吗？

sentences.en: If you'd known your visit would trigger the deaths of 900 people, would you still have gone?
sentences.zh: 如果你知道你的访问会引发900人的死亡，你还会去吗？

sentences.en: Of course not.
sentences.zh: 当然不会。

sentences.en: I would turn back the clock if I could.
sentences.zh: 如果可以的话，我会让时光倒流。

sentences.en: Jonestown was the single largest loss of American civilian life in a non-natural disaster up until the September 11 terrorist attacks in 2001.
sentences.zh: 在2001年9月11日恐怖袭击之前，琼斯镇是美国历史上非自然灾害中平民死亡人数最多的一次事件。

sentences.en: Nowadays, almost 40 years later, Jonestown still lingers in modern society.
sentences.zh: 如今，近40年过去了，琼斯镇的阴影依然笼罩在现代社会中。

sentences.en: The popular phrase, drinking the Kool-Aid, used comically towards people who easily give in to peer pressure or persuasion, is a direct reference to Jonestown.
sentences.zh: 流行的短语“喝下酷爱饮料”，常被用来戏谑那些容易屈服于同辈压力或劝说的人，这直接指代了琼斯镇事件。

sentences.en: To survivors, it's an insult.
sentences.zh: 对幸存者来说，这是一种侮辱。

sentences.en: For them, those who died in Jonestown on November 18,
sentences.zh: 对他们而言，那些在11月18日死于琼斯镇的人，

sentences.en: 1978, weren't simply a group of willing fanatical cult members as they've since been labelled.
sentences.zh: 1978年，他们并非如后来被贴上的标签那样，仅仅是一群自愿的狂热邪教成员。

sentences.en: No one will ever truly know what went through the minds of each individual as they stood before the
sentences.zh: 没有人能真正知道当每个人站在毒药桶前时，他们脑海中在想些什么，

sentences.en: vat of poison, but it's clear that a large percentage didn't want to die, and were either forced to drink or were forcibly injected.
sentences.zh: 但很明显，很大一部分人并不想死，他们要么是被迫喝下，要么是被强行注射。

sentences.en: Jim Jones's son, Stephen Jones, wasn't in Jonestown at the time of the massacre.
sentences.zh: 吉姆·琼斯的儿子斯蒂芬·琼斯在大屠杀发生时并不在琼斯镇。

sentences.en: He was in Georgetown on a trip as a member of Jonestown's basketball team.
sentences.zh: 他当时作为琼斯镇篮球队的一员正在乔治敦旅行。

sentences.en: Stephen Jones, quote, ask yourself, what would someone have to tell you or what would
sentences.zh: 斯蒂芬·琼斯引用道：问问你自己，别人必须告诉你什么，或者别人必须

sentences.en: someone have to do to you to get you to do something that you couldn't possibly believe you were capable of.
sentences.zh: 对你做什么，才能让你去做一件你根本无法相信自己会去做的事情。

sentences.en: Examine that.
sentences.zh: 审视这一点。

sentences.en: Learn from it.
sentences.zh: 从中学习。

sentences.en: Don't judge it.
sentences.zh: 不要去评判它。

sentences.en: Don't stand separate from it.
sentences.zh: 不要置身事外。

sentences.en: Be willing to stand in the shoes of the people you're judging.
sentences.zh: 要愿意站在你所评判的人的立场上思考。

sentences.en: And I hope that the 900 plus people that day died and the way they died might offer us something so that their lives won't be in vain.
sentences.zh: 我希望那天死去的900多人以及他们死去的方式能给我们带来一些启示，这样他们的生命就不会白白牺牲。
